title: Over 782,000 Singaporeans with lower CPF balances to receive up to $1,500 in top-ups by 8 December
text:
Over 782,000 Singaporeans with lower CPF balances to receive up to $1,500 in top-ups by 8 December | Lianhe Zaobao 
 Singapore International China Business Opinion Lifestyle Entertainment Search Lee Geng Wei Published / 20 Nov 2026 11:58 S M L XL Over 782,000 Singaporeans with lower CPF balances to receive up to $1,500 in top-ups by 8 December
 AI-translated article with transliterated names. Read original Chinese article here. 
 Singapore citizens aged 50 and above whose CPF retirement savings fall below the Basic Retirement Sum will receive up to $1,500 in CPF top-ups by 8 December. （File Picture） More than 782,000 older Singaporeans whose Central Provident Fund (CPF) retirement savings fall below the Basic Retirement Sum will receive up to $1,500 in CPF top-ups by 8 December. 
 The Ministry of Manpower and the Central Provident Fund Board said in a joint statement on Friday (20 November) that the top-ups, announced in Budget 2026, total $1.04 billion and are aimed at strengthening retirement security for older Singaporeans with lower retirement savings. 
 For eligible recipients aged 55 and above, the top-ups will be credited to their CPF Retirement Account (RA). Those below 55 will receive the top-ups in their Special Account (SA). 
 The authorities said the top-ups will earn higher CPF interest rates in these accounts, helping members grow their retirement savings. 
 To qualify for the top-up, recipients’ combined CPF Retirement Account and CPF LIFE balances, or their combined Ordinary Account and Special Account balances, as of 31 December 2025 must not exceed the 2026 Basic Retirement Sum (BRS) of $110,200. 
 They must also own no more than one property, and their home’s annual value must not exceed $31,000. Annual value is the estimated annual rental income a home could fetch, based on market rents for comparable properties, and is used to calculate property tax. 
 Those whose homes have an annual value of more than $21,000 but no more than $31,000 will receive a $500 top-up. 
 The top-ups will be credited automatically to eligible recipients’ CPF accounts, with no action required on their part. They will receive an SMS notification bearing the sender ID “gov.sg” once the money has been credited. 
 This is an AI-translated article and some names may be transliterated. The original Chinese text remains authoritative, and SPH Media is not responsible for translation errors.
